title: Binary Search Tree
definition: A Binary Tree where the left child is strictly smaller than the parent, and the right child is strictly greater. This allows O(log N) lookup, insertion, and deletion.
simpleExplanation: A guessing game where every time you guess a number, you are told if the real answer is higher or lower, instantly eliminating half of the remaining options.

**Advanced:** Insert into a BST
